name: May Day
text: May Day, with May Eve, is handled in this dictionary under the festivals Beltane and Calan Mai. The cross-reference sends readers to those two entries for the customs and lore of the first of May.

attributes.attribute: dictionary coverage sits under Beltane and Calan Mai
first-of-May festival point in the calendar

okr.objective: Documents May Day as recorded in MacKillop 2008 for the Public Celtic Encyclopedia.
key_results: May Day and May Eve redirect to Beltane.
They also redirect to Calan Mai.
Both targets carry the seasonal customs of the date.
